title: Choosing a transition between two clips is one obvious place, not scattered fade rows
goal: Today a clip's right-click menu offers Fade In, Fade Out, Fade In and Out and a dip to black alongside Add Transition. They overlap, each acts on one side of one clip, and none says what happens between the two clips. Picking how one clip becomes the next should happen in one obvious place, at the cut: hover the place where two clips meet, click, and pick from transitions that preview with your own two clips. Fading a clip from or to black at a free end stays available, but where it belongs (the clip's end handles), not as menu rows competing with transitions.
notes: User, 2026-10-29 (intake): 'like transition fade out, fade in, black out. these are super redundant and one sided. wondering if there is a nicer way to select a transition between 2 clips'. Same session as any-transition-goes-on-any-two-clips-that-touch (3D transitions refused between two touching recordings). Code: clip menu fade rows come from EditorState+PictureFade.swift (pictureFadeMenuRows, fadeInAndOutMenuRow) and EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift; Add Transition from EditorState+TransitionTargets.swift (addTransitionMenuRow, aimed at both ends of a clip); the picker at a cut is TransitionPicker.swift; the panel is TransitionsGroup.swift. Grown-up tool check: Premiere and Final Cut select the edit point and put the transition on it; fades are opacity handles or a dissolve at the edge.
acceptance: At Next defaults, the place where two clips meet on a track shows a clear affordance on hover (Final Cut and Premiere show the edit point). One click opens the transition picker there, already aimed at that cut: the user's mock docs/design/mocks/pages/video-transition-wt.html (#transPick) and video-transitions.html are the floor.

Each tile previews the transition with the two real clips at that cut (their last and first frames), not a generic icon, so the person sees what they get before choosing. A tile plays its motion on hover.

The clip right-click menu no longer lists Fade In, Fade Out, Fade In and Out and Add Transition as separate competing rows. One row for what happens at the cut ('Transition…' opening the same picker) when the clip meets another; fades from and to black only at an end that meets nothing, and as the end handles they already are. Dip to black and dip to white are transitions in the picker, not separate menu items.
No one-sided naming at a cut: the picker says what happens between the two clips (for example 'Cube: Recording A turns into Recording B').
Right-click on the cut itself offers the same picker plus the cut's own actions (length, curve, remove), nothing about one clip's fade.

Walks cover: hover and click a cut between two different recordings, pick Cube from a previewing tile, the transition plays; the clip menu shows no redundant fade rows; a free end still fades from black by its handle. Builds on any-transition-goes-on-any-two-clips-that-touch (a picked transition always lands).
Audit under queue/audits/ with before and after screenshots of the clip menu and the picker, marked.
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: User approved this design as written, 2026-10-29 ('yes that'): pick at the cut (hover highlights the edit, one click opens the picker), tiles preview with the two real clips and name both sides, one Transition… row in the clip menu replacing Fade In / Fade Out / Fade In and Out / Add Transition, dips live in the picker, free-end fades stay as the end handles. Build it; no decision card needed for these points.

Review before building: most of the mock already ships (hover lights the edit point, a click opens At this cut). What is missing: tiles draw stand-in colours, not the two clips; tiles all play at once rather than on hover; the picker never names the two sides; the clip menu still has Fade In / Fade Out / Fade In and Out under More and Add Transition on top (both ends at once); the cut's own menu has an Add Transition submenu, not the picker; and the fade handles show at an end that meets another clip, where a fade competes with the transition. Premiere/FCP: click edit point, pick, done; fades are opacity handles. Risk: losing 'Add Transition at both ends' — ⌘T on several picked clips still does every cut among them. Chose a Transition ▸ At the Start… / At the End… submenu over one row guessing a side when a clip meets others at both ends, because a context menu does not know which end the click was nearer. Chose to leave titles and pictures' Fade In and Out alone (user asked for it on 2026-10-19; they meet no clip) and change only recordings.
